description: This file defines the `Notification` controller class within the OpenCart admin module, responsible for fetching and displaying system notifications from the OpenCart server, managing notification cookies, and interacting with notification models.

classes.name: Notification
classes.description: Controller class handling system notifications, fetching updates from the server, and managing user notification cookies.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method invoked to fetch notifications from the OpenCart API, process the response, update notifications via the model, and set a notification cookie.
